teaser: Four candles blown out at once, a wish said loud enough for the whole room to hear — that is the kind of moment you end up steadying, uninvited. Life path 33 carries the weight of selfless care doubled; ISFP carries a private, color-soaked sense of what is true. Crossed, you become the one who notices the quiet kid at the party before anyone else does, fixes the moment without announcing it, and slips out before the thank-yous start. The pairing is tender and a little exhausting: a path built for wide devotion, housed in a temperament that needs its own room to breathe.
